# 🔍 Review Intelligence for Google Reviews

## Turns a business's Google reviews into a plain-English monthly email the owner actually reads.

The AI classifies one review at a time. Code does all the counting and every decision. The AI only turns finished numbers into sentences, which is what stops it inventing findings.

## Setup
1. Create the two Supabase tables (SQL note nearby).
2. Attach credentials: Google Business Profile, Anthropic, Supabase, Outlook.
3. Replace placeholders: YOUR_PROJECT_REF, YOUR_GBP_ACCOUNT_ID, YOUR_GBP_LOCATION_ID, emails.
4. Run **Run Test Cases**, then **Run on Live Reviews**. Enable **Monthly Run** when ready.

Built by Your Company.

# 1 · Triggers & fetch reviews

## Run monthly or on demand. Run Test Cases loads fixtures A to E; the live triggers pull Google reviews.

# 2 · Prepare & de-duplicate

## Keep only reviews never classified before. Read once, never re-ask the model, so the numbers stay reproducible.

### Attach your Supabase credential here.

# 3 · Classify once & verify

## The AI labels one review at a time. Every quote is checked against the source in code before it is stored.

### Attach your Anthropic credential here.

# 4 · Count in code

## All the math is here, never in the AI: themes, splits, severity, the 24-month trend, and staleness.

# 5 · Write the digest

## Computed facts become prose. Quiet months skip the AI entirely and are built in code.

# 6 · Deliver & remember

## Send the email, then save this month's snapshot so next month can report only what changed.

# 🗄️ Supabase schema — run ONCE before first use

```sql
create table if not exists public.review_classifications (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  location_id text not null, business_name text, review_id text not null,
  star_rating int, reviewer_name text, review_text text,
  review_created_at timestamptz, themes jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  model text, classified_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (location_id, review_id)
);
create table if not exists public.review_reports (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  location_id text not null, business_name text, report_type text not null default 'full',
  reviews_total int, new_reviews int not null default 0, average_rating numeric(3,2),
  split_count int, flag_count int, theme_counts jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  digest text, sent_to text, created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
```
## The unique (location_id, review_id) is what makes classify-once work: re-runs upsert instead of re-classifying.
